name: MAS P.L.C.

rows.label: Revenue
rows.source: MAS P.L.C. consolidated annual financial statements for the year to 30 June 2026 (audited, PricewaterhouseCoopers Malta), EUR thousand, gross revenue

rows.label: Cost of Sales
rows.source: MAS P.L.C. consolidated annual financial statements for the year to 30 June 2026 (audited, PricewaterhouseCoopers Malta), EUR thousand, service charge and other property operating expenses, the basis of the FY2025 cell

rows.label: Gross Profit
rows.source: MAS P.L.C. consolidated annual financial statements for the year to 30 June 2026 (audited, PricewaterhouseCoopers Malta), EUR thousand, gross revenue less service charge and other property operating expenses

rows.label: Operating Expenses
rows.source: MAS P.L.C. consolidated annual financial statements for the year to 30 June 2026 (audited, PricewaterhouseCoopers Malta), EUR thousand, corporate expenses 7 955 plus investment expenses 3 709 less other income 352 plus loss on disposal of subsidiary 188, the composition the FY2025 cell uses

rows.label: Operating Profit (EBIT)
rows.source: MAS P.L.C. consolidated annual financial statements for the year to 30 June 2026 (audited, PricewaterhouseCoopers Malta), EUR thousand, gross profit less the corporate and investment expenses net of other income and the loss on disposal, the construction the FY2025 cell uses

rows.label: Profit Before Tax
rows.source: MAS P.L.C. consolidated annual financial statements for the year to 30 June 2026 (audited, PricewaterhouseCoopers Malta), EUR thousand, profit before tax

rows.label: Income Tax
rows.source: MAS P.L.C. consolidated annual financial statements for the year to 30 June 2026 (audited, PricewaterhouseCoopers Malta), EUR thousand, taxation, a credit of 14 035 (current tax (3 758) and deferred tax 17 793); profit before tax 11 275 plus the credit equals profit for the year 25 310

rows.label: Net Profit
rows.source: MAS P.L.C. consolidated annual financial statements for the year to 30 June 2026 (audited, PricewaterhouseCoopers Malta), EUR thousand, profit for the year attributable to owners of the Group

rows.label: EPS
rows.source: MAS P.L.C. consolidated annual financial statements for the year to 30 June 2026 (audited, PricewaterhouseCoopers Malta), EUR thousand, IFRS diluted earnings per share 4.40 eurocents (basic 4.46), the diluted basis the FY2025 cell carries (19.49)

rows.label: ROE (%)
rows.source: Net Profit / equity attributable to owners of the Group, 25 310 / 1 206 916

rows.label: Debt to Equity
rows.source: Total liabilities / equity attributable to owners of the Group, 484 275 / 1 206 916

rows.label: Net Margin (%)
rows.derivedCellFormula: Net Margin (%) = Net Profit / Revenue x 100
